comparisons.peer_topic: 2023 Term Loan Interest, Maturity, and Prepayment Terms
comparisons.peer_summary: The 2023 Term Loans bear floating interest rates tied to SOFR, with Term A-3 and Term A-5 maturing on the third and fifth anniversaries of the VMware Merger respectively, and allow for penalty-free voluntary prepayments; the obligations are unsecured and not guaranteed by subsidiaries.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom utilize term loans with interest rates tied to the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR). AMD’s $100 million loan to an ATMP JV carries interest at SOFR plus 50 basis points and is secured by the JV's receivable from AMD. In contrast, Broadcom’s 2023 Term Loans are unsecured obligations of the company itself (not guaranteed by subsidiaries) with floating rates tied to SOFR. While both use SOFR, AMD's loan is intercompany/JV-specific and secured, whereas Broadcom's are broader corporate debt instruments.

sentences.text: On October 9, 2024, the Company entered into a one-year term loan agreement with one of the ATMP JVs for $100 million to provide funds for the ATMP JV's general corporate purposes.
The loan bears interest, payable quarterly, at the three months term Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) plus 50 basis points.
The loan is secured by the ATMP JV's receivable balance due from the Company.
The 2023 Term Loans bear interest, payable monthly or every three months at our election, at floating interest rates tied to the Secured Overnight Financing Rate ("SOFR").
Our obligations under the 2023 Credit Agreement are unsecured and are not guaranteed by any of our subsidiaries.

comparisons.peer_topic: Multi-Tranche Term Loan Payment Terms and Interest Rates
comparisons.peer_summary: The 2026 and 2027 Term Loan A require equal quarterly installment payments of 1.25% of the original principal amount, with interest generally bearing at adjusted term SOFR plus a margin of 1.00% to 2.00% depending on tranches and credit ratings.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Micron disclose term loans with interest rates based on SOFR. AMD’s $100 million ATMP JV loan bears interest at three-month term SOFR plus 50 basis points. Micron’s 2026 and 2027 Term Loan A borrowings bear interest at adjusted term SOFR (SOFR benchmark plus 0.10%) plus a margin ranging from 1.00% to 2.00%. Both companies explicitly reference SOFR as the benchmark for their respective term loan interest calculations.
